title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 10
paragraphs: The Thracians say that the other side of the Ister is occupied by bees, and that on account of them one cannot pass through and go further. But to me it seems that when they speak so, they are saying what is not likely; for these creatures are known to be intolerant of cold, and to me it seems that the regions running up toward the pole are uninhabitable because of the cold climate. Such then are the tales reported about this country. However that may be, Megabazus was at this time bringing its coastal regions into subjection to the Persians.
